answer.evidence: The roof is a large brown deck at rows 3-41, drawn as a horizontal surface seen from above. It has a parapet on the west and north edges, a stairwell box with its own lighter top (rows 5-14) and a door face below it (rows 15-23), and a caved-in hole at the north-east. The roof ends in a pale parapet front-edge band at rows 42-45, and a darker row at 46 follows. Below it the south facade runs rows 46-111, about 66 rows, with four floors of windows and balconies. The balconies show light slab tops over their railings. No receding side face is drawn, so this reads as a three-quarter view.
